scale_model.name: nonuniform_homeland_depth_v1
scale_model.implementation: The curve allocates generation/placement space by homeland depth; it does not rescale inherited coordinates.
scale_model.allocation_note: Added area is assigned to connective Wilderness, Route divergence, forest and mountain interiors, opportunity separation, and empty territory; it is not a uniform coordinate transform.
